title: 德莱文·赤金回廊
description: 德莱文在高大回廊自信站定，双斧稳稳垂持不旋转，黑色发型、小胡子与红金服装形成鲜明剪影。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Draven is an adult Noxian man with dramatically swept dark hair, a pointed curled moustache, expressive eyebrows, and a confident showman's face. Preserve his red-black costume, fur shoulder trim, and silver armor accents with a fully closed shirt, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. His two distinctive crescent-edged axes hang motionless beside the legs, never spinning, raised, or thrown.
art_direction.scene: Show him standing with composed confidence in an empty monumental arcade, shoulders angled slightly and eyes meeting a point beyond the camera. Keep both lowered axes clearly separate from his clothing. Hard gold light from above one side creates crisp wax-crayon highlights across the red cape, while long column shadows and a distant open arch provide a dramatic but peaceful setting.
art_direction.palette: vermilion, charcoal, antique gold, pale limestone
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
